name: loader

frames.best_why: The bolt is fully filled yellow and both text loaders show their offsets, covering all five in one still.

tagline: Five small loading animations, from bouncing dots to a glitching label.
summary: A set of five tiny loaders: three bouncing dots, three sliding dots, a lightning bolt that fills, glitching text and shimmering text, each looping on its own.
appearance: Five dark bordered cards on black, each holding a small animation above a grey caption: three pale dots, a tighter dot cluster, an outlined lightning bolt, and the words Loading... and Generating chat... .
behaviour: Every card loops continuously: dots bob and slide, the bolt fills and empties in yellow, the glitch label tears into green and purple copies, and the shimmer text pulses letter by letter.
demo_content: Captions Bounce, Slide, Bolt, Glitch and Shimmer, with the words Loading... and Generating chat... .
search_phrases: waiting indicator for a chat app
use_when: A chat or dashboard needs a small, characterful waiting indicator instead of a generic spinner.
avoid_when: These are five separate exports with fixed text and colours, so matching a brand needs source edits.
customise: LoaderFour and LoaderFive take a text prop; dot sizes, timings, bolt colours and glitch shades for the other three are fixed in the source.
weight_why: A few animated spans and one SVG per card, all small.

a11y.note: Nothing marks these as live status regions, and their constant loops ignore reduced-motion.

issues: The tiny grey captions under each loader are low contrast and hard to read.
polish_why: Five neat, varied loaders; the captions are tiny and the set feels like a demo.
